jobs.description: Company DescriptionAbout us:Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!How you will make an impact?The main objective of the LUCA program is to successfully upgrade METRO’s Finance to SAP S/4HANA to ensure business continuity and avoid security and compliance risks. The LUCA program is, in addition, a critical enabler of METRO’s strategy to achieve standardization, harmonization, and centralization.As a Technical Architect within the LUCA program, you will design and implement SAP finance solutions to optimize financial processes, review business requirements to deliver effective and standardized solutions. You will have a focus on Subledgers, namely on Account Receivable processes. Thus, the role requires deep expertise in SAP’s subledgers modules such as AR, AP, SD and Serrala’s Autobank solution, combined with hands-on experience in implementation and application support.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Collaborate with finance, process, and IT teams to convert requirements into practical technical designs;- Lead project rollouts solutioning of business requirements, from solution design to implementation, while analyzing complex changes and troubleshooting issues;- Ensure solutions align with Metro’s global template, enterprise architecture, SAP best practices, and compliance standards;- Simplify and convey technical concepts to diverse audiences, including executives, business users, and technical teams;- Oversee SI partner delivery by reviewing and approving requirements refinement, high level and detailed design documents, transports, customizing documentation.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or related field, with strong knowledge of Financial Accounting and Indirect Procurement;- 10+ years in SAP AP, AR, SD, with familiarity in SAP Fiori and SAP Business Technology Platform and Serrala’s Autobank as a plus;- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;- Finance-related SAP certifications are advantageous;- Retail industry experience preferred for tailored SAP solutions;- Excellent English proficiency (written and spoken);- Willingness and ability to travel as required.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Technical Architect Grade 1 (Md8).

The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

jobs.description: JOIN OUR TEAM IN BONN FOR A FULL-TIME UNLIMITED POSITION, STARTING 01 OCTOBER 2026 as Platform Lead PTP and Banking (SAP S/4HANA) in Finance Systems Transformation (f/m/x) Who are we?The 602 Finance Systems Transformation department is responsible for overall program governance & execution of the SHAPE+ Program, a cross-divisional Finance transformation program at DHL, reporting to our Group CFO. SHAPE+ is driving standardization and automation of core Accounting and Cost Accounting processes as well as Master Data Management for Post & Parcel, DHL Express, DHL eCommerce & Group Functions through rolling out a SAP-based FINANCE template with respective system consolidations. Our vision is to have the most advanced, most efficient and innovative Finance ERP platform established that supports capabilities like continuous accounting as well as real-time data processing & analytics. As Platform Lead PTP/Banking in the SHAPE+ team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and driving our global SAP S/4HANA Finance platform for Procure-to-Pay (PTP) and Banking processes. Leveraging your expertise in Accounting, Invoice-to-Pay, and SAP S/4HANA Finance, you will deliver scalable, standardized solutions across our global organization combining elements of: * Solution Governance: Own and design solutions fitting to the global PTP/ Banking template, while folding-in local deviations if legally required, in the process of implementing the template across business divisions and geographies* In-depth Process Knowledge: Commitment to harmonizing Accounting and Controlling processes in consultation with process teams and being a trusted advisor for ERP implementation, to other SMEs and business colleagues alike* Platform Advisory: Translate business and process requirements into robust techno-functional solutions, configure the ERP platform, and oversee a stable of expert implementation partners to ensure top-notch quality in an agile project environment* Continuous Improvement: Champion innovation in your area by investigating and identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and automation, while ensuring the platform evolves alongside business needs & SAP best practices* Leadership Mindset: Foster a collaborative, performance culture by demonstrating strong analytical and conceptual skills, resilience and an outcome-oriented approach, ensuring the success of the program* Additionally, knowledge in S4/HANA Material Management & MM-Inventory Management or Purchasing would be a plus – but not mandatory. Exposure to SAP BTP and CAS services, integration technologies such as REST/SOAP/oData, SAP Public Cloud projects and emerging SAP AI capabilities such as Joule 2.0 is welcomed A must? University Degree in Business Informatics (or similar), superior English skills (German a plus) and relocating to the Bonn/Cologne area, if necessary.  Who suits us? Curious people who like to deep-dive into new topics, never losing sight of the big pictureLateral thinkers who courageously question the status quo and strategize best fit solutionsPurposeful people who want to make a positive impact to our Group’s successEnthusiasts constantly looking for the best UX, process & IT solutionsPioneers who are not afraid of making the impossible possible Your benefits* Competitive compensation package with 20% variable part* Company pension plans and other forms of retirement provision* Salary conversion for environmentally-friendly commuting, leasing of company bicycle or lease of electric company car. Alternatively conventional vehicles available, too * Flexible working arrangements, such as part-time options or remote work possibilities* Health and well-being initiatives, such as sabbaticals or measures to promote a healthy work-life balance incl. health management initiatives, including preventive check-ups, sports activities* Work-family balance by offering company day care facilities in Bonn and cooperation with pme Familienservice, offering services such as childcare during school holidays* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth. Fast-paced development opportunities driven by best practices and cutting-edge solutions, keeping up with the latest trends and technologies* Collaborate with executives and senior management in the global finance community, contributing to strategic decision-making processes and become a game changer in the largest Finance transformation in the industry* Emphasis on respect and results and the opportunity to make a positive impact, such as through corporate social responsibility initiatives or involvement in charitable projects, Go Teach, Go Help, Global Volunteer Day, taking part in team-building activities or company event, such as summer party, Bonn Marathon etc.* Subsidized Germany-wide public transportation ticket and various employee discounts and offers from external providers  A highly committed team – diverse, international and fun group of skilled people that has the unique chance to make a massive contribution to our Finance unit, being exposed to positively impacting thousands of colleagues around the globe.  Your ideas & suggestions will greatly come into play. We need people that take accountability to drive things ahead, ramping up required skills along the way, fully visible and supported by senior executives and team members.  Your contactFor further information on the post, Sarah Pinapati, Head of Global Finance Platforms will be happy to answer your questions, therefore please contact sarah.pinapati@dhl.com. The application deadline is three weeks.This is a non-tariff managerial position (AT nicht leitend)  CONNECTING PEOPLE, IMPROVING LIVES

WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU ASPRODUCT SOFTWARE ENGINEER (BACK END JAVA) (M/W/D)LIMITED IN COLOGNEInterzero is one of the leading service providers in closing product, material, and logistics cycles and a pioneer in plastics recycling, operating Europe’s largest sorting capacity. Guided by the principle of “zero waste solutions,” the company supports more than 80,000 customers across Europe in the responsible handling of recyclable materials, helping them improve their sustainability performance and conserve primary  resources. With around 2,000 employees, Interzero generates annual revenues of nearly one billion euros. According to Fraunhofer UMSICHT, Interzero’s recycling activities alone saved approximately 1.04 million tons of greenhouse gas emissions and 8.09 million tons of primary raw  materials compared to primary production in 2024. Further information at: www.interzero.de.What is it about?- Collaboration: Together with Product, UX and Front-End colleagues, design and implement the Java back ends of both brand-new and evolving products you’ll stay with for the long haul.- Modeling: Translate business goals into sturdy domain models and reliable services that deliver real customer value.- Architecture: We’re moving toward a headless, microservice-oriented landscape. As a senior, you’ll help create clean APIs, refine coding standards and champion the right refactorings.- Automation: Build and refine GitLab pipelines, Docker images and workflow engines that remove manual steps - both in development and inside the products themselves.- Frontend partnership: Partner closely with front-end teams so the data, endpoints and performance they need are always there, making the user experience shine.- Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, run architecture sessions or even lead a small squad when it fits your personal goals.- Innovation: Experiment with new Java features, cloud services and patterns that help us close product loops faster. Your ideas are welcome.Advantages:- Job Security: You can expect a varied, exciting, and secure role with one of the largest environmental service providers in a future-proof industry.- Compensation: You receive performance-based pay with a strong focus on maintaining your work-life balance.- Flexibility: You benefit from flexible working hours and the option to work remotely.- Creative Freedom: You work in an environment where ideas, initiative, and creative freedom are encouraged and supported.- Flat Hierarchies: You operate within flat hierarchies and quickly take on responsibility for your own tasks.- Collaboration: You experience a culture of collaboration and respect at eye level, both within and beyond your team.- Development: You have access to internal and external training and development opportunities.- Health: You benefit from a comprehensive health management program.- Benefits: You receive attractive perks such as corporate benefits, bike leasing, free drinks and fruit on-site, and coverage of the Germany ticket or an Edenred card.Profile:- Experience: 5 + years of professional Java experience, ideally with Spring Boot and Hibernate/JPA.- Expertise: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design, relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), and containerization with Docker.- Frontend-Familiarity: Familiarity with our frontend technology stack (React/Next.js/TypeScript) can be advantageous; if you want to work full-stack, you can.- DevOps: Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD — our DevOps team handles the heavy lifting, but you know your way around.- Architectural Judgment: A sense for clean architectures, test automation, and the judgement to choose the right pattern at the right time.- Languages: Fluent English (German is a bonus), a collaborative mindset and genuine curiosity about how products succeed in the real world.- EU-Work: A valid EU work permit; candidates already based in Germany (or nearby EU countries) are strongly preferred.Contact:Yannick Bartschhr@interzero.deErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Softwarearchitektur, Software testenErweiterte Kenntnisse: Datenbankadministration, -management, -organisation, REST (Representational State Transfer), Java Persistence API (JPA), Backend-Entwicklung, Programmiersprache Java

Are you ready to take the commercial lead of a global Service business and drive its next phase of profitable growth?

KK’s Service business generates approximately DKK 800m in annual revenue and is an increasingly important contributor to the company’s growth and profitability. To build on this strong foundation, we are looking for a Senior Director, Global Service Sales to lead our international Service Sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China.

In this role, you will have overall responsibility for driving profitable growth across the Service business. You will set the commercial direction, strengthen key customer relationships and further develop our sales capabilities, while ensuring strong execution across pricing, pipeline management and business development.

Reporting to the VP Service, you will be a key member of the Service leadership team and play an important role in shaping the future direction and continued growth of the business.

The role

We are looking for a commercially driven leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution and people leadership.

You know how to set a clear direction and turn commercial ambitions into results. At the same time, you stay close to customers, markets and your organisation, giving you a strong understanding of where the opportunities are and what it takes to capture them.

As a leader, you create clarity, accountability and momentum. You build strong teams, empower people to take ownership and bring the organisation with you as the business continues to grow.

Key responsibilities:

As Senior Director, Global Service Sales, you will have overall responsibility for driving the commercial development and performance of our global Service business. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Service business, driving sustainable and profitable growth across markets

• Identify and develop new business opportunities while strengthening KK’s aftermarket and Service offering

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and strategic stakeholders

• Strengthen pricing discipline, commercial decision-making and account management across regions

• Build a strong sales pipeline and improve forecasting, commercial planning and performance follow-up

• Translate market developments, customer needs and competitive insights into concrete commercial opportunities

• Lead, develop and motivate an international sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China

• Build a strong performance culture with clear accountability, customer focus and commercial excellence

• Develop commercial capabilities and future leaders while ensuring the organisation is equipped for continued growth

• Work closely with Service Operations, Engineering, Project Management and other functions to ensure strong commercial execution

• Drive collaboration and knowledge sharing across regions and act as a visible and trusted member of the Service leadership team

Your profile

We are looking for a commercially driven leader with a strong track record of delivering growth through people, customer relationships and business development.

You will likely bring:

• Significant experience in senior commercial or sales leadership roles, ideally from Service, Aftermarket or other similar recurring revenue businesses. Experience within the wind industry is advantageous.

• Responsibility for delivering profitable growth in an international business

• Experience leading teams across multiple countries and cultures

• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking

• A proven ability to build customer relationships at senior levels

• Experience operating successfully in a matrix organisation

• A structured and data-driven approach to sales management

Location

Ikast, Denmark

How to Apply

If you can see yourself in the role and match the above qualifications, we look forward to receiving your application. Please note that due to vacation in week 42, we will start review candidates in week 43.

For questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact:

Anne Høj

anhoj@kkgroup.com

About KK Group

Building on more than 40 years of experience, KK Group is a leading systems supplier to the renewable energy industry. Our capabilities span the development of state-of-the-art technologies, high-quality lean manufacturing, and flexible aftermarket services.

KK Group is owned by A.P. Moller Holding, the parent company of the A.P. Moller Group, established in 1904 by Arnold Peter Møller. We are a global and diverse organization of more than 3,700 employees, working to deliver products and services that enable a future powered by renewable energy.

At KK Group, our culture and DNA are built on a foundation of a can-do attitude and innovation. We actively foster an inclusive work environment that embraces diversity, rejects any form of discrimination, and ensures equal opportunities for all. Our commitment is to cultivate a strong culture centered on health, safety, wellbeing, and effective teamwork.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

What you will do

Drive retail campaign experiences

• 
Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• 
Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• 
Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• 
Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

Lead global campaign toolkits

• 
Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• 
Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• 
Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

Lead and develop creative talent

• 
Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• 
Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• 
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

Partner across the business

• 
Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• 
Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• 
Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

Deliver from concept to execution

• 
Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• 
Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• 
Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Who you are

You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

We imagine you bring

• 
Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• 
Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• 
Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• 
Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• 
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• 
Professional fluency in English.

What will make you stand out

A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Operations team, working primarily with Azure, AWS and partially in GCP. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that all engineers think about automation and streamlining first.

Your Role & Impact

We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We want to build a modern, strong and scalable platform for our many subsidiaries(120+ companies) and we need the right people to do that.

You will be doing hands-on work on our many platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities

• Operate and optimize Egmont’s multi-cloud environments

• Automate routine and repetitive tasks and streamline operations.

• Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring in our tools – We use Datadog

• Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standard and detect drift

• Drive modernization initiatives to reduce manual work and promote automation

• Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

• Experience from previous cloud engineering, operations or DevOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (GCP is also a plus)

• Scripting skills in any popular language

• Experience with IaC tools, any apply but we use Terraform

• Good understanding of networking

• Experience working with modern observability tools like Datadog

• Knows how to setup, configure and operate server based infrastructure, running both Linux and Windows

• Working with source control in GitHub or similar providers

• Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s rethinking how cloud operations are done.

Why Egmont?

At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1120 Copenhagen K, Denmark

• Application deadline: November 14, 2026

• Interviews: Will be scheduled from week 47.

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

To apply, please use the "Apply" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Sabine Lübcke (Senior IT Manager, Cloud & Network) at sabine.lubcke@egmont.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

Are you passionate about product data and the systems that turn it into consistent, high-quality experiences everywhere it's used? Do you enjoy the technical challenge of connecting complex data flows across platforms? Do you thrive on making product information easy to find, understand, and trust—for customers and for AI? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Pandora's team is looking for a Product Manager to own our Product Information Management (PIM) practice. PIM is central to our architecture, syndicating product data to ecommerce, marketplaces, retail, and marketing systems, so you'll work at the intersection of data architecture, content quality, and discoverability.

As our new Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy and delivery for our PIM platform, with InRiver preferred as our PIM technology. You'll work closely with data, engineering, and content teams to define the data model, govern data quality, and ensure product information flows correctly to every downstream channel.

This role is critical to how our products are found and understood—not just by customers on our own site, but increasingly by AI-driven answer engines and generative search. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands-on technical execution, vendor management, and continuous improvement of our data model.

Help Write Our Next Chapter - Job Responsibilities:

• Own the product roadmap and backlog for our PIM platform, ensuring the data model and architecture support both business and technical needs

• Design and optimize data flows between PIM and downstream systems (ecommerce, marketplaces, DAM, ERP), working closely with engineering

• Partner with content, SEO, and marketing teams to structure and enrich product information for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

• Manage vendor relationships, including roadmap alignment, issue escalation, and feature adoption

• Monitor data quality, syndication performance, and platform health, identifying optimization opportunities and driving continuous improvement

• Stay ahead of trends in PIM, product data architecture, and AI-driven discovery, bringing forward strategic recommendations

We would love if you could bring:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, data platforms, or PIM—ideally within ecommerce or product content operations

• Technical understanding of PIM architecture, data modeling, and system integrations (APIs, ETL, syndication)

• Experience with InRiver or similar PIM platforms preferred

• Experience optimizing product information for AEO and GEO—structured data, schema markup, and content formats that AI systems and search engines can parse

• Experience writing clear product requirements and managing backlogs in tools like JIRA

• Analytical mindset with a focus on measuring data quality and discoverability impact

• Excellent stakeholder management skills—you can navigate between technical and business teams with ease

• Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, consent management) is a plus

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we’d love to hear your story!

Meet the People Behind the Sparkle

You’ll join our Product Management team, alongside colleagues in Copenhagen and Baltimore, working in a collaborative and international environment. Reporting directly to the Director, Product Management, you’ll work closely with teams across e-commerce, stores, retail technology, brand, marketplaces and local markets, giving you broad exposure across Pandora and plenty of opportunity to collaborate across the business.

Further Information:

Global Career Band: This role is a Manager, Band 4B, individual contributor position.

Be Part of Something Beautiful

At Pandora, we’re crafting more than jewellery. We’re creating the future of an iconic global brand. You’ll work from our Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen alongside talented colleagues from around the world, helping shape the digital experiences, platforms, and technologies that support millions of customers and employees every day. From our LEED Gold-certified workplace to our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and craftsmanship, Pandora offers an environment where you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a lasting impact.

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology site in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s ambitions. Besides our inspiring workplace design, we’re proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This reflects our commitment to using natural resources responsibly and creating a space that is professional, dynamic, comfortable, and uniquely Pandora. The result is a workplace that is innovative, collaborative and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here or comes to visit.

Join us in this role where you will contribute to the development and implementation of our global workplace strategy and translate business requirements into effective, future-focused workplace solutions. Working closely with internal specialists and external partners, you will bring together the expertise needed to shape solutions aligned with our global Love Your Workplace concept. You will lead workplace projects from early location analysis and space planning through workplace programming, where data, business requirements, work patterns and stakeholder needs are translated into clear workplace requirements and design briefs. The role combines workplace project leadership, strategic space management, data analytics, and stakeholder engagement, with a strong focus on workplace experience and performance.

**Welcome to Global Real Estate & Workplace Management

**You'll be part of Workplace Development, a team within Global Real Estate & Workplace Management (GREWM). Together, we're responsible for developing and evolving Love Your Workplace, our global workplace concept for how offices are designed, used, and experienced across the organization. We collaborate with colleagues across Facilities Management, IT, People & Culture, Procurement, Security, and business leadership to create workplaces that support collaboration, wellbeing, productivity, and sustainability.

As a team, we bring together diverse professional backgrounds and expertise to continuously improve workplace experience for our colleagues around the world. You'll join a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and where you'll have opportunities to influence workplace solutions across our global portfolio.

**You'll play an important role in:

**

• Implementing and managing global workplace concepts, standards and policies, while driving the adoption and continued reinforcement of activity-based working

• Translating organizational, functional, and employee requirements into practical workplace solutions and a clear project-specific vision

• Leading workplace projects from pre-project planning and location assessment through programming, design, delivery, implementation, handover, and post-occupancy follow-up

• Advising on space requirements and supporting real estate and lease-selection decisions through test fits and workplace data

• Leading and coordinating the development of project briefs, zoning principles, test fits, layouts, and design plans in collaboration with decision-makers and workplace ambassadors

• Applying and continuously improving occupancy and capacity-planning methodologies

• Identifying opportunities for right-sizing, consolidation, and portfolio optimization, and supporting workplace business cases and project prioritization

• Supporting in collecting and analyzing real estate, people, occupancy and utilization data and converting findings into actionable recommendations

• Using and contributing to the development of workplace KPI and benchmarking frameworks to support evidence-based decisions

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Bring strong workplace project leadership skills, combined with strategic workplace understanding and solid end-to-end project management experience, preferably from workplace, office fit-out or implementation of ABW projects.

• Understand workplace from both a built-environment and user perspective and are passionate about creating great workplace experiences

• Are curious and ambitious about the future of the workplace and how workplace solutions can continuously evolve to meet changing business and user needs

• Have strong analytical capabilities within occupancy, capacity, utilization and portfolio planning, and can communicate complex findings clearly

• Understand how workplace performance can be evaluated through user experience, occupancy, utilization and other workplace performance measures, and use these insights to continuously improve solutions

• Can effectively coordinate multiple projects and priorities at the same time

• Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across different functions, seniority levels and cultures

• Communicate clearly and confidently, whether discussing workplace concepts with senior leaders or supporting users through workplace change

• Enjoy working collaboratively and influencing outcomes through engagement and partnership rather than formal authority

• Are structured, proactive and able to navigate a complex international organization with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• Are willing to undertake occasional business travel, primarily within Central Europe and the UK

• building strong relationships with senior sponsors, regional and local stakeholders, business leaders and cross-functional partners

**Maybe you've read the above and can see you have some transferable skills

**Even if your experience doesn't match every requirement, we'd still like to hear from you. We recognize that valuable skills and perspectives come from different industries and backgrounds. Finding the right colleague matters more than a specific location, so we're open to candidates based in Denmark, London, or Warsaw. If you're excited about creating great workplace experiences and believe you can contribute to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application as soon as possible. We'll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we've found the right candidate

**Join a global leader in renewable energy

**Ørsted is a growing green energy major and a global leader in climate action. Here, you'll contribute to creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. You'll work alongside skilled colleagues in an international environment where trust, collaboration, learning, and development are part of everyday life. We offer opportunities to grow your career while helping shape solutions that have a positive impact on both people and society.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.occupation: Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, Assens, DK / Global Customs & Trade Compliance
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by ensuring full compliance in a complex and fast-evolving regulatory landscape? As our new Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, you'll play a key role in safeguarding STG's global trade flows and reducing customs-related risk. You'll work closely with Planning, Customs & Transportation, Procurement, and Finance to keep customs processes compliant, efficient, and well-documented.

What your day will look like

• Manage and follow up on import and export procedures to ensure compliant, timely customs flows

• Monitor and implement customs legislation changes and country-specific obligations

• Set up and oversee customs regimes such as EMCS (Excise Movement and Control System), IPR (Inward Processing Relief), and bonded warehouse processes

• Classify products and determine valuation and origin (HS – Harmonized System, ECS – Export Control System, FTA – Free Trade Agreement) for accurate declarations and duty management

• Support SAP-based customs processes as a basic user (training provided)

• Conduct regular risk assessments and manage customs claims, with proactive mitigation and clear documentation

Keystakeholders

Material Planning · Customs & Transportation · Procurement · Finance · Manufacturing · Tax/Legal · IT/Reporting · SST · Warehousing

What you'll bring

• Proven experience in customs & trade compliance, including hands-on work with import/export processes and customs regimes

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in declarations and documentation

• Analytical ability to interpret and apply legislation

• Proactive, service-oriented mindset with strong stakeholder collaboration skills

• Danish language proficiency and valid Danish ID Card

• Working proficiency in English

Nice-to-have: Descartes software experience

• Advantage: experience with AEO (Authorised Economic Operator), UCC (Union Customs Code), CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism), EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation), or customs audits

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.  At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 432,000–648,000 annually corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Our recruitment process

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you’ll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:.

• Recruiter screening

• First round: interview with the Hiring Manager - 1 hour, technical depth

• PI assessment

• Second round: interview with a Senior Stakeholder – 30–45 min

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

Posting Start Date:  10/8/26

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

• Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (STG headquarters)

• Working hours: Approx. 20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams

• Work model: On-site at our headquarters in Gentofte

• Contract type / duration: Student position, part-time

Are you a curious and proactive student who enjoys working with sustainability, data and emerging technologies? Do you want to contribute to meaningful ESG initiatives at an international company? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Student Assistant, you will be part of the Sustainability Centre of Excellence and play an important role in supporting the delivery of Rolling Responsibly, our sustainability agenda and a key enabler of our corporate strategy, Focus2030. You will contribute to a wide range of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) initiatives while helping strengthen our sustainability data, reporting and insights. You will refer to the Global Head of Sustainability. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience with sustainability strategy, reporting requirements, climate data, supplier engagement and AI-enabled analytics in an international company.

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an international FMCG company with operations in 20 countries and approximately 9,000 colleagues worldwide.

What your day will look like

In this role, you will typically focus on:

• Collecting, validating and analysing sustainability data from suppliers, including Scope 3 emissions, packaging compliance, no-deforestation, Supplier Code of Conduct and due diligence data.

• Generating insights from supplier data, including information collected through our participation in the Sustainable Tobacco Program.

• Calculating and analysing the CO₂ footprint of packaging solutions using internal tools and supplier data.

• Monitoring data quality, identifying gaps, and following up directly with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

• Conducting sustainability research and preparing presentations, reports and briefing materials for senior management and other stakeholders.

• Supporting sustainability reporting and regulatory initiatives, including CSRD, PPWR and other ESG requirements.

• Maintaining sustainability documentation, evidence and reporting records.

• Assisting in the development of AI-enabled and automated data collection, reporting and analytics solutions.

• Supporting communication activities, presentation development and sustainability-related content creation.

What you'll bring

• Currently enrolled in the first year of a Master's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, Data Analytics, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel capabilities. Experience with Power BI a plus. Knowledge of Python, ThinkCell and Efficient Elements is an advantage.

• Interest in sustainability reporting, climate data, supply chains, responsible sourcing and ESG regulation.

• Detail-oriented with an understanding of how sustainability information contributes to the Annual Report under CSRD.

• Project management skills are an advantage.

• Comfortable working independently after receiving guidance and eager to learn new technologies.

• Structured and able to manage multiple priorities and ad hoc requests.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG, you'll find more than a role — you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

For this role, we offer 160 DKK/hour corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

Incentives and Benefits: you will gain hands-on experience in an international company, with approximately 20 hours of work per week and flexibility around exams.

If you are passionate about sustainability and data and want to contribute to meaningful ESG initiatives, we would be pleased to receive your application. Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

Our recruitment process
